sources.result: Canonical URL recheck attempted all 18 owned Madhya Pradesh district scopes. Fourteen pages returned HTTP 200; nine returned tehsil tables suitable for roster-level comparison. Several pages were unavailable, empty, document-only, or internally inconsistent. Seoni lists nine rows but says there are eight tahsils. Rewa Division currently lists 9 Rewa, 10 Satna, 7 Sidhi, 6 Singrauli and 3 Mauganj entries; Maihar entries remain listed in Satna on this page despite the separate Maihar district page.
sources.limits: Tehsil labels/counts do not identify current legal footprints; this partial, inconsistent publication set cannot establish province completeness or boundary identity. Keep all unmatched names and incomplete pages unresolved.
